values: App Shell, Header Metrics, and Reset
As an analyst, I want the app to open with headline economics and a reset control so I can quickly understand the scenario and return to defaults.

The single page app renders the title, subtitle, CAPEX, annual revenue, payback, IRR/equity IRR, and viability status. Reset restores default state, clears the share hash, syncs controls, recalculates, and shows "Reset to defaults".
Reset while non-default hash is present; reset after off-Earth or AI state; reset after custom saved-site state; status message is transient and non-blocking.
Browser reset flow verified on default, Mars, saved-site, and invalid-input cleanup states.
DOM requires resetStateButton and headerActionStatus; reset uses normalized defaults and recalculation; hash sync removes default diff.
index.html, js/app.js, js/app-renderers.js, js/app-share-state.js, js/state-schema.js, js/calculations/*.
Viability labels are model indicators, not investment advice.
index.html header; js/app.js recalculate/reset methods; js/app-renderers.js header metrics.
As a mobile user, I want Inputs, Overview, and Results pane controls so I can operate the calculator on a narrow viewport.
At mobile breakpoints only one main panel is displayed at a time. Pane buttons update active styling, aria-expanded, panel aria-hidden, and Escape returns to Overview.
Viewport crossing 900 px; direct Results navigation; hidden panel content retains recalculated values; Escape key on mobile.
390x844 browser pass verified pane display and ARIA state for Overview, Inputs, and Results.
mobile-pane-toggle data-panel-target values must map to configPanel, diagramArea, and resultsPanel; panel state is driven by updateMobilePaneState.
index.html mobile-pane-tabs; style.css media rules; js/app.js bindMobilePaneControls.
Desktop layout keeps all panels available without pane toggles.
index.html mobile pane buttons; js/app.js mobile pane methods.
As a user scanning many settings, I want sections to collapse and expand so the interface remains navigable.

Clicking or keyboard-activating a section header toggles the open class on its containing section. Headers expose button semantics, aria-expanded, and aria-controls. Open sections show body content and collapsed sections are hidden from assistive technology.
Clicking nested controls must not unintentionally toggle; Enter/Space keyboard activation; default open sections differ between config and results; hidden inputs remain synchronized.

D-008 fixed missing keyboard and assistive-technology state on collapsible section headers. Automated section-toggle tests now cover role/tabindex, aria-controls, aria-expanded, hidden body state, click, Enter, Space, and body id preservation.

Section headers use data-toggle and are bound by bindSectionToggles; each header must control a section-body id, expose role=button/tabindex=0, and keep aria-expanded plus body hidden/aria-hidden in sync.
index.html config-section/results-section markup; style.css section state; js/app.js setupSectionToggles.
The header itself is the clickable control; there are no separate accordion buttons.
js/app.js bindSectionToggles; tests/ui/section-toggles.test.js; index.html section markup.
As a user, I want short explanations for technical labels without cluttering the UI.
Elements with data-tooltip show a shared tooltip on hover or focus, update position on resize/scroll, and hide on mouseout/focusout.
Keyboard focus; viewport resize; scroll while tooltip open; repeated labels with custom tooltip text.
Renderer tests verify custom data-tooltip usage; code path audited for hover/focus handling.
Tooltip source must be data-tooltip; app-rendered labels use custom tooltip attributes instead of native title.
js/app.js setupTooltipBehavior; js/app-renderers.js custom tooltip labels; style.css tooltip styles.
Tooltips are explanatory only and are not required to complete workflows.
Slider Guide Markers and Log Ticks
As a user changing numeric assumptions, I want reference markers so common benchmark values are discoverable.
Configured sliders render clickable marker buttons with aria labels/tooltips. Log-scale sliders render visual tick marks.
Markers outside min/max are ignored; resize repositions markers; marker clicks update value and dispatch input.
Markers observed in browser control inventory and code path audited.
SLIDER_MARKERS entries must reference existing range inputs; marker value must be inside input min/max.
Markers are guidance values and do not constrain user input.
As a user, I want annual-average economics with an optional Earth specific-day display so I can inspect seasonal shape without changing the annual model.

Annual Average is default. Specific Day is available for Earth and updates chart display/day metadata only. The mode buttons expose aria-pressed state and the Specific Day detail controls are hidden from assistive technology unless active. Non-AI annual economics and sizing remain tied to annual yield.
Solstice/equinox presets; day slider bounds; non-Earth disables Specific Day and exposes aria-disabled; specific-day clipping display.
D-003 added explicit button types to day-mode and day-preset controls. D-009 added Analysis Cycle aria-pressed, aria-disabled, and hidden/aria-hidden synchronization for Specific Day controls.

dayOfYear is range-bound; specific-day state is display-only for annual economics; non-Earth forces average mode; day-mode buttons expose aria-pressed and control daySpecificControls hidden/aria-hidden state.
js/app-controls.js day controls; js/app-ui-state.js planetary UI; js/solar-geometry.js; tests/calculations.
Specific day is a visualization lens, not a daily TEA case.
tests/calculations/calculations.test.js specific-day tests; tests/ui/html-contract.test.js; tests/ui/day-mode.test.js; js/app-ui-state.js; js/app-charts.js.
As a user comparing Earth, Mars, and Moon scenarios, I want cycle and solar assumptions to adjust by body.
Location presets set body/profile/yield/coordinates. Mars and Moon use local-cycle labels, disable Earth specific-day controls, and show map fallback when satellite imagery is unavailable.
Mars orbital-year AI basis; lunar polar shadow proxy; switching back to Earth restores map and specific-day availability.
Browser Mars flow verified disabled Specific Day, map fallback, hash update, and recalculated metrics.
Body must be one of earth, mars, moon; non-Earth chart notes and map empty state must reflect limited imagery.
js/reference-data.js planetary bodies/location presets; js/calculations/calculations-solar.js; js/app-site-map.js.
Off-Earth yields are model presets and not live measured weather feeds.
Location Presets and Manual Site Inputs
As a user, I want preset sites and manual latitude, longitude, and annual yield controls so I can model a target location.
Preset selection fills body, solar profile, latitude, longitude, yield, and source. Manual edits mark the site custom and, for Earth non-manual yield, estimate GHI and annual yield from coordinates.
Latitude/longitude/yield clamping; custom site without saved name; manual yield source; off-Earth custom coordinates.
Preset selection verified in browser; invalid input normalization covered by automated tests.
Latitude range -90 to 90; longitude -180 to 180; yield 500 to 3500 MWh/MWdc-year; normalized before calculations.
Annual yield is user-provided or heuristic, not fetched from external irradiance APIs.
tests/calculations invalid input test; js/app-controls.js bindNumber/handleLocationEdited.
Saved Site Presets and Site Snapshots
As a repeat user, I want to save a custom site and restore its app-specific snapshot later.

Custom sites expose a save name input. Save creates a localStorage preset and selects it. Saved options use s:<id> values. Remove deletes the preset and stored app state, returns to Custom location, and exposes save controls again.
Empty name; max 80 characters; localStorage unavailable or write failure; saved preset deleted while selected.
Browser flow saved and removed QA Browser Site; automated tests cover persistence and cleanup.
Name strips control characters and truncates at 80; max presets is 48; saved app state is normalized before load.
js/saved-site-presets.js; js/app-controls.js saved site bindings; browser localStorage.
Saved sites are browser-local and not synced to a server.
As a user, I want non-default assumptions encoded in the URL so I can share a scenario.
The app reads #s= compressed state on load/hashchange, applies supported version 1 diffs, rejects invalid payloads with feedback, and writes only non-default normalized state back to the URL hash.
Unsupported version; unrelated anchors; empty payload; LZString unavailable; default state removes hash.
Automated hash round-trip tests and browser non-default hash/reset flows passed.
Share payload is object {v,d}; derived batteryEnabled is excluded; unsupported versions throw and are caught by app feedback.
Share URLs carry model inputs, not full chart images or local saved-site storage.
As a user, I want to configure PV size, efficiency, module cost, degradation, mounting, BOS, land, and site prep assumptions.
Solar controls update annual production, capacity factor, land/panel area, solar CAPEX, and LCOE. Mounting type changes shape and resets BOS to the mounting default.
Extreme latitude/yield; east-west dense packing; Mars/Moon profile; zero or high cost bounds; degradation replacement effects.
Automated tests cover land use, BOS response, CAPEX sum, and yield behavior.
State schema clamps numeric ranges; mounting type must exist in MOUNTING_TYPES; BOS sync follows selected mounting.
PV output is a deterministic TEA model, not hourly weather-year simulation from a live API.
As a user, I want to model battery capacity, cost, round-trip efficiency, and cycle life to see firmed process power and cost.
Battery controls update effective capacity factor, daily hours, buffered LCOE, battery CAPEX/O&M, clipping, charge/discharge, and replacement schedule.
Zero battery with AI mode; tiny capacity sweep; leakage retention; high/low efficiency; battery-backed chemical clipping.
Automated tests cover no-battery, buffered cost, clipping, and AI storage behavior.
Battery capacity derives batteryEnabled; efficiency and cycle ranges are clamped; storage leakage is applied monthly.
Battery dispatch is deterministic and optimized for modeled capture/reliability, not merchant arbitrage.
tests/calculations battery and AI storage tests.
As a user, I want to undersize process equipment relative to solar peak so I can trade CAPEX against clipped energy.
Chemical sizing percent caps process nameplate. Charts and notes show clipped solar when the cap binds. Full-capture reference is preserved for comparison.
No battery versus battery-backed cases; 70 percent aggressive shaving; no displayed clipping; AI residual chemistry.
Automated clipping tests passed for battery and no-battery modes.
chemicalSizingPercent is clamped 50 to 100; optimizer can adjust this control; clipping arrays must align to chart labels.
Sizing percent is applied to modeled full-capture peak, not to grid-interconnected plant nameplate.
tests/calculations undersizing tests; js/app-charts.js clipping display.
As a user, I want separate Chemical and AI Compute controls so the process setup is not overloaded.

Chemical and AI tabs update active classes, aria-selected, roving tabindex, panel hidden/aria-hidden state, and visible load-config panels without losing state. Arrow, Home, and End keys move focus/selection across the tablist.
Switching tabs after enabling AI; keyboard-only navigation; mobile pane hidden state; controls in inactive panels retain values.

D-007 fixed incomplete tablist semantics and missing keyboard navigation. Static HTML contract and runtime tab behavior tests now cover ARIA wiring, hidden panels, roving tabindex, Arrow navigation, Home, and End.
data-load-tab values map to panel data-load-panel values; tabs use role=tab with aria-controls; panels use role=tabpanel with aria-labelledby; selected tab state stored as loadConfigTab.
Tabs are local UI state and are included in share state only when non-default.
index.html load tab markup; js/app-controls.js tab methods; tests/ui/html-contract.test.js; tests/ui/load-config-tabs.test.js.
As a user, I want to enable or disable electrolyzer, DAC, Sabatier methane, and methanol modules to model core product routes.
Supported modules render from ModuleCatalog, expose toggles and config controls, calculate CAPEX, output, revenue, feed surplus, and diagram cards when active.
Downstream module without upstream dependencies; disabled output rows omitted; multiple downstream products share H2 and CO2 production.
Automated tests cover dependencies, output omission, and supported presets.
Enabled downstream modules auto-enable dependencies; module IDs must exist in ModuleCatalog; disabled rows do not render.
Supported routes are more modeled than exploratory routes but still simplified TEA assumptions.
Module Presets, Custom Values, and Asset Life
As a user, I want process module presets and custom assumptions so I can compare cost/performance cases.
Preset selection updates paired module config values and selects Custom when values no longer match a preset. Module asset life contributes to replacement schedule.
Custom values via slider; preset values with log-scale controls; replacement cycles inside analysis horizon.
Automated tests verify paired preset mapping and custom detection.
Preset values must map to known state keys; state values are normalized before calculations.
Preset labels are bundled assumptions, not sourced live from vendors.
As a user running both methane and methanol, I want to set feedstock allocation between products.
When methane and methanol are active, the product mix control appears, adjusts H2/CO2 allocation, and the optimizer can find a split with better IRR.
Only one downstream product active; split optimizer button hidden/disabled; feed surplus after allocation.
MTG browser flow exposed shared feedstock split after auto-enabling methanol.
methaneFeedstockSplit is clamped 0 to 100; control only displays when both downstream products are active.
js/app-ui-state.js dynamic visibility; js/calculations/calculations-process.js allocation; js/app-optimizer.js.
Split is a model allocation preference, not a physical process control loop.
As a user, I want buffer sizing options for feed-dependent modules so peak-day CAPEX can differ from average output.
Buffer-capable modules default buffers on. Buffers preserve annual output while sizing affected equipment from peak-day average gas or methanol flow.
MTG upstream methanol buffer; buffer disabled on unsupported modules; CO2-to-CO route buffer.
Automated feed-buffer tests passed for Sabatier, methanol, CO, and MTG.
Buffer controls only exist for catalog modules with feedBuffer support; default state enables supported buffers.
Buffer sizing is a rough daily peak smoothing model.
As a user exploring industrial extensions, I want rough route toggles for MTG, CO, ammonia, specialty carbon, lime, cement, steel, silicon, aluminum, titanium, and desalination.
Exploratory modules render from catalog, expose route/priority/CAPEX controls, calculate rough output and economics when enabled, and list missing assumptions/context.
Multiple routes enabled; route-specific feedstock limits; output units differ by module; market controls shown only when output exists.
Automated tests cover multiple exploratory routes, capex, markets, and diagram inputs.
Route IDs must belong to the module; enabled routes calculate from electricity and feedstock constraints; price units follow catalog market definition.
Exploratory modules are explicitly rough and should not be treated as engineering designs.
As a user enabling methanol-to-gasoline, I want methanol production to split between export and MTG feedstock.

Enabling MTG auto-enables methanol and dependencies. The methanol diversion control appears when MTG and methanol are active. Methanol export is reduced by MTG consumption and hydrocarbons appear in production/economics.
MTG enabled without explicit methanol; 0/100 diversion; methanol buffer upstream; MTG route output near zero shown with units.
Browser MTG flow verified dependency auto-enable and exploratory output/economics; automated MTG tests passed.
mtgMethanolSplit is clamped 0 to 100; MTG depends on methanol route and upstream H2/CO2 dependencies.
js/app.js MTG split control; js/app-ui-state.js visibility; calculations-process MTG route.
MTG gasoline output is reported as generic hydrocarbons.
As a user, I want to allocate solar and storage to AI compute first and send residual energy to chemistry.

AI Compute tab enables reliability target, GPU CAPEX, token price, throughput, and AI asset life controls. AI load is auto-sized for reliability, production adds AI tokens, economics include AI revenue/CAPEX, and residual chemistry updates.
Zero explicit battery seeds from annual solar GWh; high reliability targets; off-Earth dispatch; AI-only large scale; hidden AI sensitivity until output exists.
Browser AI flow verified tab, toggle, AI token output, recalculated metrics, and hash update; automated AI dispatch tests passed.
Reliability target must be a supported option; AI enabled state controls config active class and calculations.
js/calculations/calculations-series-ai.js; js/app-controls.js AI tab/toggle; js/app-charts.js AI dispatch display.
Token revenue and throughput are user assumptions, not live market prices.
tests/calculations AI tests; browser AI execution log.
As a user, I want one-click optimizers for selected controls so I can search for higher IRR without manually sweeping ranges.

Optimizer buttons run battery, chemical sizing, or methane feedstock split sweeps. Worker is used when available, with main-thread fallback. Progress text/aria updates and the best finite improvement is applied.
Worker creation failure; worker import error; synchronous postMessage failure; no positive improvement; rapid repeated clicks; long sweeps; optimizer disabled by inactive controls.
D-006 fixed stale optimizer request bookkeeping when Worker postMessage fails. Automated optimizer progress, lean IRR parity, Worker fallback, Worker error, and asset-version resolver tests passed.
Optimizer targets known state keys and bounded sweep ranges; progress callback is monotonic; failed Worker requests must be rejected and removed from the pending request map.
Optimizers seek model IRR, not global multi-variable optimum.
As a user, I want price controls for methane, methanol, and exploratory outputs so revenue can reflect target markets.

Methane market preset updates methane price. Methanol price control appears when methanol output exists. Exploratory market controls appear only for enabled modules with output and catalog market definitions.
No product output; AI-only scenario; green methane premium values; exploratory route with no market definition.
MTG browser flow verified exploratory market controls; automated exploratory economics custom price tests passed.
Price controls use catalog units and clamped range values; empty state appears when no matching output exists.
js/app-ui-state.js dynamic visibility; js/module-catalog.js market definitions; calculations-economics.
Prices are nominal user inputs, not fetched from market APIs.
Incentive Scheme Selection and Dynamic Inputs
As a user, I want to select a named incentive scheme and see only the relevant input controls and caveats.

Policy select populates named US, European, framework-only, and custom schemes. Selecting a scheme renders its active inputs, applicability, modeled basis, stacking rule, note, and US caveats when applicable.
Framework-only no-cash-flow programs; custom mixed support; US-only caveats; negative CfD support.
Browser policy flow verified US 48E dynamic input and caveats; automated catalog coverage now checks all exposed scheme metadata and input bounds.
policyMode must map to POLICY_SCHEMES or legacy alias; policy input values are clamped by definitions.
js/policy-model.js; js/app.js renderPolicyInputs; js/app-ui-state.js dynamic visibility.
Only one named scheme is modeled at a time except custom mixed support.
js/policy-model.js; browser policy execution log; tests/calculations policy catalog tests.
Policy Cash-Flow Evaluation and Legacy Migration
As a user with older links, I want legacy policy modes to map into current schemes and cash flows consistently.
Legacy policy aliases normalize into current policyMode/input state. Policy evaluation computes upfront support, annual support, output metrics, duration, and capex allocation where applicable.
No policy; 45Y versus 48E exclusivity; 45V/45Q output dependence; EU/UK CfD negative support; framework-only informational modes.
Automated tests cover legacy migration, 48E, 45Y, CfD, no-policy timeline behavior, and finite economics outputs for every exposed policy scheme.
Policy result must reconcile to cash-flow timeline and economics breakdown; legacy payloads should not crash.
Policy model is deterministic TEA simplification and not legal/tax advice.
tests/calculations policy tests and catalog-wide policy economics tests.
As a user, I want asset life, analysis horizon, and discount rate controls so project NPV/IRR/payback reflect my evaluation window.
Solar asset life, analysis horizon, and discount rate update capital recovery, replacement schedule, NPV, IRR, payback, and economics charts. Debt term is capped by horizon.
Short horizon; replacement cycles near boundary; multiple IRR roots; no real IRR root.
Automated tests cover IRR root selection, cash-flow timelines, replacement schedule, and payback variants.
analysisHorizonYears clamps 3 to 30; discountRate clamps 0 to 20; IRR solver selects largest positive/economically relevant root.
Annual cash flows are year-end except close/upfront support bucket.
As a user, I want to enable debt financing and see equity IRR alongside unlevered project returns.
Debt toggle opens debt assumptions, changes headline label to Equity IRR, calculates debt-funded upfront CAPEX, level debt service, sponsor support where needed, DSCR, equity IRR, and equity payback.
Zero interest; debt term beyond horizon; debt service exceeds operating cash; disabled debt returns unlevered headline.
Browser financing flow verified active config and equity IRR header; automated debt schedule tests passed.
Debt share 0 to 90; interest 0 to 15; term capped by analysis horizon; upfront fee 0 to 5.
js/app-controls.js financing toggle; js/app-renderers.js financing headline; calculations-economics/core debt schedule.

tests/calculations financing tests; browser financing execution log.
As a user, I want annual O&M controls by equipment category so operating costs reflect site assumptions.
Solar, process, battery, and active exploratory M&O percentages feed annual O&M, levelized cost, annual profit, and economics breakdown.
Exploratory O&M hidden with no output; battery disabled; land/site prep excluded; high O&M making negative cash flow.
MTG browser flow verified exploratory O&M visibility; economics automated tests cover O&M effects through cash flows.
O&M percentage controls are clamped by slider ranges and applied to installed CAPEX categories only.

Calculation Normalization, Validation, and Dependency Enforcement
As a user, I want invalid or incomplete inputs to be normalized before calculations so the app does not produce impossible or crashing states.
Calc.normalizeState clamps values, applies defaults, derives batteryEnabled, normalizes legacy policy modes, and enforceModuleDependencies enables upstream modules required by downstream routes.
NaN/undefined values; off-range numeric values; downstream-only links; unsupported hash version; saved snapshot from older state shape.
Automated tests cover invalid input normalization and dependency auto-enable.
All calculations call normalized state before use; module dependencies are catalog-driven.
UI number fields may temporarily display user text while editing, but calculation state is normalized before model execution.
tests/calculations invalid inputs and dependency tests.
As a user, I want fast quality signals for scenario viability and score drivers.

Header status is Viable when NPV is positive and payback is within horizon, Marginal when NPV or final cumulative cash is positive, otherwise Not viable. Project Score combines ROI, payback, utilization, feed balance, and design-rate badges.
Levered headline switch; negative IRR; no payback; high ROI but low utilization; financed case with sponsor support.
Browser screenshots and flows verified header metrics and project score updates.
Viability uses project NPV/payback, not equity-only values; score is clamped 0 to 100.
Score is a heuristic for user triage, not a formal credit/investment rating.
As a user, I want a system diagram showing how solar, storage, AI, and process modules connect.
Diagram renders SVG cards and connectors from calculated results, including average/peak power and material flow labels. Cards appear for active supported and exploratory modules.
Narrow layout; AI-first dispatch; exploratory modules with electricity-only or feedstock inputs; no downstream products.
Desktop and dist browser checks verified SVG; automated diagram formatting test passed.
Diagram.render receives buildDiagramDisplayResults output; labels use formatted peak and average magnitudes.
js/diagram.js; js/app-renderers.js updateDiagram; style.css diagram classes.

Specific-day Earth display; Mars/Moon cycle labels; battery charge series; clipped data alignment; no Chart.js.

js/app-charts.js updatePowerChart; tests/renderers/charts.test.js; browser render checks.
